job_purpose: Run CBACT02C to read the card master VSAM KSDS sequentially and print every card record to SYSOUT (JCL comment: 'RUN THE PROGRAM THAT READS THE CARD MASTER VSAM FILE'; program header: 'Read and print card data file').

source_artifacts.type: JCL (upstream: IDCAMS define/load of CARDDATA KSDS + AIX)

output_datasets.content: DISPLAY output: start/end banners, one 150-byte CARD-RECORD line per record, error diagnostics

called_modules: CEE3ABD (LE abend service, only on I/O error)
dependencies: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS must exist and be loaded (produced by CARDFILE.jcl STEP10/STEP15)

programs.purpose: Read and print card data file
working_storage: APPL-RESULT S9(9) COMP with 88 APPL-AOK=0, APPL-EOF=16
business_functions: Sequential full-file listing of card master records in primary-key (card number) order
error_handling: OPEN status != '00' -> DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE', file status, abend U999
READ status other than '00'/'10' -> DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE', file status, abend U999
CLOSE status != '00' -> DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING CARDFILE', file status, abend U999

fields.name: CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE
fields.note: name misspelt in source; observed values YYYY-MM-DD

other_users: CICS FILE CARDDAT (COACTUPC, COACTVWC, COCRDLIC, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC)

dependencies.note: no scheduler definition in repo; ordering is by data dependency only

dependencies.kind: tools/runjcl/chains.json order READACCT -> READCARD -> READXREF -> READCUST
dependencies.note: no data dependency between the four readers

business_functions.name: Card master listing
business_functions.description: Read every record of the card master KSDS in ascending card-number order and write each 150-byte record verbatim to SYSOUT between start/end banner lines.

business_functions.name: I/O failure detection and abend
business_functions.description: Any non-'00' OPEN/CLOSE status or READ status other than '00'/'10' prints a diagnostic and abends via CEE3ABD with code 999.

business_functions.name: File status formatting
business_functions.description: Status printed as 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' + 4 chars; numeric status -> '00'+status; non-numeric or stat1='9' -> stat1 + 3-digit binary value of stat2.

observed_logic.transformations: none (record moved READ ... INTO CARD-RECORD and displayed as-is)
observed_logic.validation: file status checks only; no field-level validation
observed_logic.sorting: implicit ascending primary-key order from KSDS sequential access
observed_logic.report_generation: SYSOUT DISPLAY listing, no headers/page breaks

verified_behaviour.r01-populated: 2 records listed in key order, RC 0 (fixtures/read-masters/r01-populated/expected/sysout/READCARD.STEP05.txt, rc.json)
verified_behaviour.r02-empty: empty KSDS: only start/end banners, RC 0 (fixtures/read-masters/r02-empty)

risks.description: SYSOUT prints full card number and CVV (CARD-CVV-CD) in clear for every record; target must decide whether to preserve, mask or restrict.
CEE3ABD (LE) abend with U999 must be mapped to a target failure/exit-code convention.
KSDS is shared with CICS FILE CARDDAT (SHAREOPTIONS 2 3, DISP=SHR); a batch read may see in-flight online updates. No close/open of CICS file in READCARD.
Dataset names AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.* are hardcoded in JCL; no symbolic parameters.
No scheduler (Control-M/TWS) definition in the repo; production run frequency, predecessors and restart policy are unknown.
On-host data is EBCDIC; off-host fixtures are ASCII line-sequential with trailing FILLER spaces trimmed, while SYSOUT lines carry the full 150 bytes. Target must reproduce 150-byte padded output.
SYSPRINT DD is allocated but never written by CBACT02C.
A Java/Spring Batch read-masters port already exists in java/read-masters (docs/BATCH-RESTART.md); PySpark target would be a parallel implementation.
